basic_info.description: Looked a long time at buildings in South Beach before deciding myself on this unit in the Watermark ten years ago, never looked back. Two free weeks of rent for Mid August move-in. Corner 2 Bed and 2 Full Bath Home on 19th floor w/ a Outdoor Patio overlooking Bay, SF City Skyline and Twin Peaks at the Iconic Watermark Building, a step away from Waterfront. This sophisticated home has amazing views from every room and is finished with Brazilian Hardwood Floors in the living spaces, carpets in bedrooms, Custom Lighting and Window Treatments, In-Unit Washer/Dryer. Master bathroom features Double Vanity, Marble Floors and Counter-Tops, Walk-in Shower and Soak-in Tub. The open floor plan was designed for entertaining, with a fully equipped Chef's Kitchen featuring Custom Island, Absolute Black Slab Granite Countertops, Sub-Zero and Bosch Appliances w/Gas Stove, Cooktop, Oven, Dishwasher. Parking included, most pets ok. I will do minor renovations when tenant moves out (paint, deep clean). The pictures at the end of the listing are from a friend's unit downstairs, same corner in case you want to see with some furniture.
